emotion_and_vibe: Authoritative, trustworthy, clear, and high-end. A modern interpretation of government/financial data that feels like a premium SaaS product (e.g., Stripe, Notion).

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Utilize a fixed sidebar for filters and a fluid grid for the portfolio cards. Every pixel must be utilized intelligently.

grid_system.card_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6

sidebar_filters.style: w-full lg:w-72 flex-shrink-0 lg:sticky lg:top-8 lg:max-h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] overflow-y-auto rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm
sidebar_filters.elements: Range sliders (Shadcn Slider) with dual thumbs if possible or numeric inputs for ranges. Multi-select (Shadcn Command/Popover). Reset button at the bottom.

portfolio_card.style: group relative flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200/60 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_12px_30px_-10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]
portfolio_card.hover_state: Subtle scale-up of logo, border color changes to primary-300.
portfolio_card.content_layout: Top: Avatar/Initials (w-12 h-12 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 border border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center) + Incubator Name. Middle: Sector (Badge), City/State. Bottom: Total Grant Remaining prominent.

sticky_header.style: sticky top-0 z-40 w-full backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200 py-4 px-6 md:px-8 flex justify-between items-center
sticky_header.elements: Global search (Input with icon), total results count, sort dropdown, theme toggle.

modal_dialog.tabs: Shadcn Tabs: Basic Info, Financial Data, Additional Metadata. Content should be dense and structured, like a control room.

badges.style: inline-flex items-center rounded-md px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-700

motion_and_interactions.hover: Cards lift (-translate-y-1) and cast a diffuse shadow.
motion_and_interactions.list_entrance: Framer Motion staggered entrance for grid items (opacity 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0).

icons_and_assets.usage: Minimalist stroke icons. Use for search, filter headers, location pins, and empty state.
icons_and_assets.empty_state: Display a large Lucide Database or PackageOpen icon with a muted color, bold title 'No portfolios found', and a clear reset button.

hero_background.description: Optional subtle background texture for the header or empty state (use with low opacity)

technical_instructions_to_main_agent: Implement infinite scroll using react-intersection-observer or similar pattern.

The API URL is https://seedfundapi.startupindia.gov.in:3535/api/portfoliofilter. It's a POST request for filtering if applicable, or GET. Check the actual endpoint structure. If CORS fails, mock the data beautifully based on the fields mentioned.
Global search must filter across incubator_name, sectors, city, state locally if not supported via API directly, or debounced via API.
Range sliders need minimum and maximum inputs. Consider using Shadcn Dual Slider if you can build it, or two numeric inputs for each range (min/max).
The empty state must have a reset filters button.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='incubator-card-1', data-testid='global-search-input').
Since it's a premium SaaS dashboard, NO generic 'card' component from Shadcn if it feels too boxy; build the card using raw div with Tailwind as per `portfolio_card` guidelines.
For the modal, use Shadcn Dialog and Tabs.
